title: RPM LEARN LearningEvent v2
description: Learning event identity schema v2. LearningEvent is learner-role only; Teacher/Employer/Admin actions are separate OS/control streams. Runtime EVENT_POLICY_VERSION 4 enforces learner role binding, monotonic active-time derivation, no retroactive credit after a meaningful-interaction idle gap longer than 45 seconds, AUDIO_STARTED as audit-only for time purposes, provenance-bound AUDIO_ENDED listening credit, exact source-event linkage, single attribution per source event, replay quarantine for invalid/legacy events, audit metadata, and speaking human-review gate. EVENT_SEMANTIC_POLICY_VERSION 2 recomputes deterministic ITEM_ANSWERED outcomes from stored responses and canonical immutable items, binds state-changing events to the canonical current lesson path, rejects learner-authored MASTERY_APPLIED mutations, verifies item/media/speaking bindings, blocks premature completion, and quarantines the replay tail after semantic/path corruption.
